name: Deep Diver Minnow Hard Lure
description: An exquisite 12cm hard bait featuring internal rattling tungsten chambers. Under rapid recovery, its elongated diving lip drags it down to 6 meters, mimicking a wounded baitfish with energetic side-to-side kicking.
features: Internal tungsten bearings transfer weight to the tail for laser-flat casting
Emit low-frequency rattle waves to alert deep predator fish
Fitted with double saltwater-grade razor-sharp treble hooks

name: Popper Pro Topwater Lure
description: The ultimate topwater thrill maker. The Popper Pro features an extreme concave front cup that throws massive water sprays and makes deep chugging bubble sounds that tempt gamefish to smash the surface.
features: Deeply dished mouth creates dramatic splash action and cavitation bubbles
Perfectly tail-weighted configuration sits at a 45-degree angle when static
Heavy duty 3D holographic eyes act as strike trigger points

name: Spinner Bait Deluxe Bass Lure
description: Constructed with dual gold-finished willow blades, a hand-tied silicone skirt, and an ultra-stiff wire frame, this spinner bait generates massive underwater vibrations to lure big largemouth bass.
features: Dual willow blades deliver high flash and low water resistance for deep pulling
Indestructible piano-grade spring wire frame handles multiple catches
Weedless layout snakes through underwater branches easily

name: Soft Shad Pack Paddle Tails
description: Infused with organic salt and shrimp scent extract, these soft paddle-tails wobble back and forth on the slowest retrievals. Pack includes 6 premium scent-sealed swimbaits.
features: Scent-infused rubber keeps fish holding on up to three times longer
Deep slot along back hides hook points for a truly weedless layout
Dynamic paddle tail beats vigorously at all speeds

name: Jerkbait Elite Suspending Lure
description: An incredible suspender hardbait. When you pause your reel, this jerkbait halts exactly in place, hovering horizontally like a real fish catching its breath. Highly effective in cold-water bass seasons.
features: Neutrally buoyant formulation keeps the bait suspended mid-water on pauses
Responds to snaps of the rod tip with erratic 90-degree darting actions
3D gills and laser-etched scales provide high realistic styling
